pages.title: A Second Heart
pages.text: A dragon heart resonates like a second heart, drawing on nature's power to restore health slowly.

pages.title: Crafting the Necklace
pages.text: Name tag above, heart between two spore blossoms, dragon blood below. Heart and blood types may differ.

pages.title: Healing Severe Injuries
pages.text: The heart works in either form. Recovery is slower during severe injury; once fully healed, the dragon sits and awaits a command.$(br2)Spore blossoms grow in lush caves.
